title: Review of c14's pdrop arrest negative: on fresh seed 4 droplets form from noise and arrest as a static emulsion (101 droplets, 4 persistent splits vs 35 merges); F 0.004 and Du 2 screens hold 60-64 and 66-69 droplets over 16000 steps
summary: Ran the finding's world.py with labkit on fresh seed 4 (rerun/seed4; defaults F 0.01, Du 0.3; 80 frames x 250 steps) and the author's scr.py on seed 4 at F 0.004 and at Du 2.0 for 16000 steps (screen/). labkit: ~100 droplets appear from the uniform soup by t~375-875 and then sit packed and nearly still to t=10000 (101 at the end, 101 persistent tracks), with 11 splits against 35 merges, 4 persistent splits and max generation 1 (rerun/seed4/sheet.png shows the same frozen emulsion from t~3000). Screens: F 0.004 keeps 60-64 small droplets (median area 23-26) and Du 2 keeps 66-69 droplets (median area 85-96) from t=2000 to 16000, a drift of at most 7%. The negative replicates on this seed.

observations.S: rerun/seed4/sheet.png t=0: uniform soup; droplets by t=375
observations.finding: rerun/seed4/FACTS.md: 4 persistent splits, 35 merges, max generation 1; screen/F0.004_s4.txt 60-64 droplets and screen/Du2_s4.txt 66-69 droplets over t=2000-16000

controls_run.finding: screen/F0.004_s4.txt and screen/Du2_s4.txt: two of the author's screen settings on the same fresh seed

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and 3 of the 11 settings; the screens count droplets, not births and deaths, so a balanced birth-death turnover at constant count is excluded only by the labkit lineage of the default setting.
